description: This Java class 'LiveSignalPubSubFactory' is a final class that extends an abstract pub-sub factory, designed specifically for handling live signal messages within a pub-sub architecture. It provides methods to create pub-sub instances for signals, extracting messaging topics based on streaming type, and is integrated with Akka actor contexts.

classes.name: LiveSignalPubSubFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating pub/sub handlers for live Signal messages, providing topic extraction based on streaming types.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of LiveSignalPubSubFactory based on the given ActorContext.

methods.name: getStreamingTypeTopic
methods.description: Private static method that derives pub/sub topics from a given Signal based on its StreamingType.

methods.name: topicExtractor
methods.description: Private static method that returns a PubSubTopicExtractor configured to extract topics from Signals.
